notes.title: Gallery Subtitles added
notes.notes: [p]Update V1.8h - onwards[/p][p]Subtitles for the Gallery have now been added and can be activated from the Options Menu, before starting the game or when menus are active during gameplay.[/p][p]The majority of the game remains Subtitled due to the style – lines found in the ‘Found Footage’ sections can’t be turned off.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37308309/3bc61cc99f7675a5d8d292aa1c6768ab246414e1.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Lammana - Demo Launch
notes.notes: [p]Very excited to be presenting the [b]Demo [/b]for [b]Lammana[/b] as part of the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]. This game is made by myself, developer Jonathan Boakes - Darkling Room, based in Looe, Cornwall, which is also the setting of [b]Lammana[/b], all be it in the 1920s.[/p][p]Lammana is an adventure mystery… as you play the ‘[i]Found Footage[/i]’ of William H Boston, presented in a modern day gallery in NYC, where Boston began his adventure. He vanished in 1924, never to be seen again, some say 'foul play', others claim madness and isolation. What brought Boston to Cornwall? Why did he meticulously record his every activity?[/p][p]All is revealed as you progress through the mystery. Help us work out what happened to William, witness the strange and disturbing footage, and solve the mystery that surrounds Lammana, the ancient name for the island off Looe which Boston made home.[/p][p][b]Spoilers[/b] – The demo presents you with a slice of gameplay, introducing the setting, presenting some characters, uncovering clues and items and then diving beneath the waves to investigate. All of this, and much more you’ll find in the full game, screenshots and trailers.[/p][p]Please add the game to you [b]Steam Wishlist[/b].[/p]
